title: IG-11
subtitle: Independent
description: As a dangerous assassin Droid, outlawed across the galaxy, IG-11 was programmed to follow all of the protocols of the Bounty Hunter's guild to every exacting letter. He hunted "the asset" for a mysterious client, but met his match against the Mandalorian Din Djarin. After being reprogrammed, he found new life as a nursemaid to Grogu, and once again as the new Marshal of Nevarro.
